h1: Data extraction that fills your fields for you
overview: If someone on your team retypes names, dates, totals and item lines from documents into a sheet, we can take over the typing. We agree on the exact fields you need, build a reader for your document types, and send each result to a sheet or database row. Anything the reader is not sure about is marked so a person can confirm it.

faq: What do you need from me to start?
Twenty or more real samples of each document type, and a list of the fields you want with a short note on each. We confirm the field list with you in writing before building anything.

It depends on how clean and consistent your documents are. We measure results on your own samples, share the numbers, and mark unsure values so a person checks them. We do not promise a fixed accuracy figure.
Can it handle documents in different layouts?
Yes, within limits. Each package states how many layouts it covers, and we test every layout on real samples. New layouts later can be added as a small extra job.
Will you see my private documents?
We only open the samples you share, inside your own accounts, and we do not keep copies after handover. If a document holds sensitive details, tell us and we can use cropped or masked samples.
